title: Currents are sequentially continuous at every test form
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P (= Eucl P) be an arbitrary set. Let S ∈ D_k(U) (= GeometricCurrentOn U k: a linear functional on D^k(U) = TestFormOn U k with S(ϖ_l) → 0 whenever TestFormOnConverges ϖ 0). Let (e_l)_{l∈ℕ} be a sequence in D^k(U) and ω ∈ D^k(U) with TestFormOnConverges e ω. Then S(e_l) → S(ω) as l → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (e : ℕ → TestFormOn U k) (ω : TestFormOn U k), TestFormOnConverges e ω → Tendsto (fun l => S (e l)) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))
